    Residual separation inside object-deletion stages #

    The residual subgroup is selected from support-overlap degrees of one ambient finite module family. A nonzero shifted map in an invariant deletion stage already produces an overlap of the corresponding extended ambient supports. Consequently the same avoidance certificate makes every deletion-stage subfamily whose extensions lie in the ambient window shift-Hom orthogonal.
